name: Sakuno
source:
Skills: Aikido, darts, helping her master in anything
Hobbies: Taking care of Maika (her master), reading, [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Day_trading]day trading[/url]
Likes: Cabbage rolls, flowers
Dislikes: Alcohol, tobacco

[spoiler]Sakuna is the illegitimate daughter of [url=/c32691]Maika's[/url] mother the current queen and a different father than the king. Though she is only a maid she is Maika's precious older sister.[/spoiler]
